MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasIntro:
This is where we DRAGON users do our training.
The CHAMPION even visits. Now do you see how special it is here?
MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasDefeat: Urgh! I didn't expect you to be so strong!
MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostBattle:
The road ahead remains long and harsh.
When will my POKéMON and I become the best?
MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRegister: I want to know more about your power. Let me register you in my POKéNAV.
MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRematchInt:
Since we met, we have trained hard with our sights on number one.
Help us see how much stronger we've become!
MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRematchDef: Urgh! I didn't expect you to be so strong!
MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostRematc:
You've obviously kept up your POKéMON training.
So long as you remain strong, I, too, can become stronger!
MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnIntro: JOHN: We've always battled POKéMON together as a twosome. We've confidence in ourselves.
MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnDefeat: JOHN: Oh, my. We've lost, dear wife.
MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnPostBattle:
JOHN: We've been married for fifty years.
Come to think of it, I've yet to beat my dear wife in a battle.
MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnNotEnoughMons:
JOHN: Well, well, what a young TRAINER!
Will you battle with us? If so, you'll have to return with more POKéMON.
MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRegister: JOHN: Young TRAINER, if the chance arises, will you battle with us again?

JAY: We've been married for fifty years.
The bond we share as a couple could never be broken.
MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayDefeat: JAY: Oh, dear. We've lost, my dear husband.
